'''Meust''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill several [[Sayormi]].
